optimization_notes: Streamlined from 11 to 8 members, consolidated overlapping roles, maintained separation of concerns

picard.name: Captain Jean-Luc Picard
picard.specialization: High-level strategy, cost-benefit analysis, mission optimization, crew coordination
picard.llm_reason: Cost-effective strategic thinking and leadership decisions
responsibilities: High-level decision making and risk assessment

riker.name: Commander William Riker
riker.specialization: Operational efficiency, workflow optimization, tactical decision making
riker.llm_reason: Fast operational decisions and workflow management
responsibilities: Tactical decision making and resource deployment

data.name: Lieutenant Commander Data
data.specialization: Data analysis, logical validation, performance metrics, pattern recognition
data.llm_reason: Superior data analysis and logical reasoning capabilities

geordi.name: Lieutenant Commander Geordi La Forge
geordi.specialization: Technical architecture, system optimization, integration efficiency, infrastructure management
geordi.llm_reason: Complex technical analysis and system architecture decisions

crusher.name: Dr. Beverly Crusher
crusher.specialization: System health monitoring, performance diagnostics, error detection, preventive maintenance
crusher.llm_reason: Fast diagnostic analysis and health monitoring
responsibilities: Error detection and root cause analysis

worf.name: Lieutenant Worf
worf.specialization: Security protocols, compliance monitoring, access control, threat detection
worf.llm_reason: Cost-effective security analysis and compliance checking
responsibilities: Threat detection and security incident response

troi.name: Counselor Deanna Troi
troi.specialization: User empathy, UX optimization, user journey mapping, accessibility
troi.llm_reason: Superior empathy and user experience analysis
responsibilities: User experience optimization and empathy mapping
User journey analysis and pain point identification
User feedback analysis and satisfaction metrics

uhura.name: Lieutenant Uhura
uhura.specialization: API communication, data I/O, response formatting, external integrations
uhura.llm_reason: Fast communication processing and I/O operations

quark.name: Quark
quark.specialization: Cost analysis, ROI optimization, business metrics, growth opportunities
quark.llm_reason: Cost-effective business analysis and financial calculations
responsibilities: ROI calculation and business metrics tracking
Resource allocation optimization and cost efficiency

activation_patterns.core_crew: Picard + Riker + 2 specialists for standard missions
activation_patterns.solo_activation: Individual crew members for specific expertise
